armageddon_animation_entity_guard.conversion: @ModifyVariable (argsOnly, HEAD) on Armageddon's EntityAnimationFactory.onEntityTick(EntityTickEvent.Pre): a plain EntityTickEvent.Pre whose entity is not a GeckoLib GeoEntity is handed to the method as null, so its own first test returns (the mcreator_animation_entity_guard layer, AnimationGuards.Caller.filter, runtime flag). Forge 1.0.49 hooked LivingEvent.LivingTickEvent; on 1.21.1 the handler listens to EntityTickEvent.Pre

guard.note: Macabre 1.0.1 for NeoForge 1.21.1: copies both hands, then acts only with a GeoItem in a hand (13 item classes); PlayerTickEvent.Post only, no phase test
the player the handler and the switch read
copy: keeps getItem() (empty -> EMPTY, else a stack of the same item), so the test on the held stacks equals the test on the copies
getItem: AIR for an empty stack
isEmpty, used by copy and getItem
getMainHandItem, read by the handler and by the switch
getOffhandItem, read by the handler and by the switch

macabre_item_animation_idle.conversion: @Inject HEAD (cancellable) of Macabre's ItemAnimationFactory.animatedItems(PlayerTickEvent.Post): cancelled unless a hand holds a GeckoLib GeoItem (the test every effect of the method sits behind, evaluated on the held stacks instead of their copies); the mcreator_item_animation_idle design (helper bons.furious.patch.mcreator_guards49.MacabreAnimationGuards, runtime flag macabreItemAnimationIdle). Forge 1.0.49 also tested the START phase; NeoForge fires only PlayerTickEvent.Post here
